domain: All26^5 five-letter lowercase startup seeds, lexicographic aaaaa..zzzzz.
encoding: One byte per seed: a sufficient counter c in0..34, not necessarily the first successful native output.
proofCandidate: For each seed, all initial six-byte words at counters0..c are nonzero, and output byte0 at c is in1..101. Thus normalization of each attempted first draw has a finite bound; the chosen first draw is strictly below102/256<0.4. The integer/native/source correspondence and kernel certificate check are open.
nativeOrder: Game.ClickCookie calls loseShimmeringVeil(click) before cookieClicks++; the first accepted click after ordinary Reset uses seed/0.
reproduction: node preflight.mjs (records the explicit scratch path /tmp/cookie-audit; see file)
node free-veils.mjs (conditional source fixture; see explicit premises)
scope: No policy reads the seed or certificate; a policy simply attempts consecutive direct clicks and stops on the visible native award.
No repeated reset is used. The source fixture starts from an independently fixed ordinary final-run reset, sells all native starter buildings, waits for gains, and buys only zero-price veil toggles.
The source fixture supplies prior milestones/heavenly ownership and worst seed awjiu; it is not a path from a new save.
The long new-save run remains immutable and uses its original controller.
openObligations: Kernel-checked exhaustive seed certificate with ARC4/source refinement.
Complete source/physical-input and callback-termination bridge for reset, sale, zero-production, toggle and accepted clicks.
Prove no retained flat9-CpS quoted egg upgrade in the final normal run; the new policy excludes it from permanent-slot candidates.
Compose the actual full new-save entry and all remaining goals; no expected-time or optimality result follows from this certificate alone.
